SELECT sa.*, ap.package_name, ap.package_image, ap.package_price, ap.product_id FROM scenic_article sa LEFT JOIN article_package ap ON sa.article_id = ap.article_id WHERE sa.status = 1
AND (sa.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sa.excerpt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sa.merchant_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND sa.region = #{region}
ORDER BY sa.view_count DESC, sa.like_count DESC
ORDER BY sa.publish_time DESC
ORDER BY sa.featured DESC, sa.publish_time DESC
